plugins.name: write-natural-text
plugins.description: One skill, /write-natural-text, that writes, rewrites, or checks English text so it reads like a real person wrote it: plain B1-level words, a personal view, uneven structure, no AI writing tells, ASCII punctuation only. Ships the voice guide and a research-backed catalog of AI writing signals with the fix for each.
